verdict.rationale: Stagehand's core primitives (act/observe/extract) are explicitly documented as natural-language, DOM-understanding actions that discover elements and execute them, with selfHeal to re-infer actions when selectors break, plus automatic iframe/shadow DOM handling — directly matching the story. Community feedback corroborates the self-healing/resilience claim (dynamically regenerating Playwright actions vs brittle hardcoded selectors), though skepticism about cost-effectiveness exists as caveat, not contradiction. Missing for 10: independent, rigorous benchmark of selector-survival across real layout changes (community evidence is anecdotal/qualitative only).
